title: Agent Curation Proposals
description: Stage 2 agent-proposed roll structure and evidence, awaiting human review. This file is NOT the trusted corpus and must never be loaded as one: it lives in data/derived/ (machine-produced, regenerable by re-run) precisely so the separation from data/manual/chapter_roll_overrides.json is physical rather than conventional. Its roll objects deliberately mirror chapter_roll_overrides.schema.json's shape so the Forge Curator review flow needs no translation layer.

curated_by.description: Always "agent" here. A human-curated entry never appears in this file.

rolls.description: Same loose array as the corpus schema, carrying the same roll-object shape.

_stage2.description: Per-run provenance and the per-roll evidenced/not-found record that makes review confirm-or-correct rather than start-from-blank.

quote_tiers.description: Verification tier reached per located quote (1, 2, or null).

unlocated_quotes.description: Model-proposed quote text that could not be found in real prose. Preserved verbatim for human judgment and never given an invented position.
